title: The Night Black Like Me's Factory Burned, and the Fortnight After
conflicts: Slate year 1985 is the founding; the fire was 17 November 1993 (approx_date 1993-11). Insurance: Mashaba (2015) says insurers paid slowly and he got less than half the value lost; Bizcommunity (2002) says nest egg plus what he could get from insurers; 21 Icons says insurance did not compensate; story follows Mashaba and mentions savings. Burned plant: Mabopane (Bizcommunity, 21 Icons) vs Garankuwa (News24 2004, not cited because blocked); story says near Pretoria / Mabopane. Colgate sale: Mashaba ties it to the fire, News24 2004 to import competition; story attributes his view to him. Buy-back August 1999 (Mashaba) vs mid-1999 (Bizcommunity).
notes: Founder interview (BizNews/BrightRock Change Exchange, 2015) carries the night and the decision; Bizcommunity (2002) and 21 Icons corroborate. Funding set to bootstrapped: started on a R30,000 private loan (repaid in seven months per one report), rebuilt from savings and insurance. Quote stance: complicates (Gita's equanimity toward profit or ruin vs his focus on success).
